title: The leader opens the registrations of an event from the events list
description: The ministry leader signs in, opens the events list and follows the Inscritos link of the retreat to see the spots counter and the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/entrar
Fill the field E-mail with lider@pibls.test
Fill the field Senha with the password given in the instructions
Click the button Entrar
Navigate to /admin/eventos
Verify the event TS Retiro de inscritos is listed
Click the link Inscritos in the row of TS Retiro de inscritos
Verify the heading Inscritos is visible
Verify the text 4 de 20 vagas preenchidas is visible
Verify the table has the column headers Inscrito em, Nome, Telefone, E-mail and Tamanho da camiseta
Verify the table shows the names Ana Souza Teste, Bruno Lima Teste, Carla Dias Teste and Diego Rocha Teste

title: The registrations list can be searched by name
description: Typing part of a name in the search field narrows the table to the matching person.

steps.description: Sign in at /admin/entrar as lider@pibls.test with the password given in the instructions
Navigate to /admin/eventos/45/inscritos
Verify the text 4 de 20 vagas preenchidas is visible
Type carla in the search field labeled Buscar
Wait up to 30 seconds, until the table stops showing Ana Souza Teste (the search is applied after a short delay and a server request)
Verify the table shows Carla Dias Teste
Verify the names Ana Souza Teste and Diego Rocha Teste are not shown in the table

title: The leader exports the registrations as CSV and as PDF
description: Both export buttons download a file and confirm it with a message.

steps.description: Sign in at /admin/entrar as lider@pibls.test with the password given in the instructions
Navigate to /admin/eventos/45/inscritos
Verify the text 4 de 20 vagas preenchidas is visible
Verify the text starting with O arquivo exportado tem dados pessoais is visible
Click the button Exportar CSV
Verify the message CSV baixado. appears
Click the button Exportar PDF
Wait up to 45 seconds: the message Gerando o PDF… appears first and is replaced by the confirmation when the file is ready
Verify the message PDF baixado. appears

title: Cancelling a registration asks for confirmation and gives the spot back
description: The leader cancels Diego, first keeping the registration and then confirming, and the counter goes from 4 to 3.

steps.description: Sign in at /admin/entrar as lider@pibls.test with the password given in the instructions
Navigate to /admin/eventos/45/inscritos
Verify the text 4 de 20 vagas preenchidas is visible
Click the button Cancelar a inscrição de Diego Rocha Teste in the table
Verify the dialog text A inscrição de Diego Rocha Teste será excluída definitivamente e a vaga liberada. Confirmar? is visible
Click the button Manter inscrição
Verify the text 4 de 20 vagas preenchidas is still visible and Diego Rocha Teste is still in the table
Click the button Cancelar a inscrição de Diego Rocha Teste in the table
Click the button Cancelar inscrição in the dialog
Verify the message Inscrição cancelada. A vaga voltou a ficar disponível. appears
Verify the text 3 de 20 vagas preenchidas is visible
Verify Diego Rocha Teste is no longer in the table

title: A leader cannot open the registrations of another ministry's event
description: The event TS Evento de outro ministério belongs to a ministry that is not the leader's, so its registrations page says the event was not found.

steps.description: Sign in at /admin/entrar as lider@pibls.test with the password given in the instructions
Navigate to /admin/eventos/46/inscritos
Verify the text Não encontramos este evento. is visible
Verify the name Elisa Prado Teste does not appear anywhere on the page
Verify the text vagas preenchidas is not on the page
